brief.t: START HERE: Call Aaron and Evelyn, with Sam looped in, to settle Silk Factor’s lot disposition before further fulfillment.

ACT NOW 1: Silk Factor — discrepancy 15 days old. Luke signed; microbial/QA disposition, batch-record conflicts and lot-specific shipment traceability remain unresolved. Aaron/Evelyn need an authorized decision. Send internally: Aaron, Evelyn and Ron, reconcile both Silk lots, microbial results, batch records and shipments with Sam today; record authorized disposition before further fulfillment.

ACT NOW 2: Roon/Luke QC — finish the handoff and run decision. You forwarded six Lotioncrafter COAs to Evelyn yesterday; receipt, lot matching and FSS handoff remain unverified. The QC request is three days old. Roon’s requested December 1 run is three days away and not approved; actual R7 test timing remains unknown. Sender-reported label delivery is not PLL receiving or QA release. Send internally: Evelyn and Ron, confirm the six forwarded LC COAs and existing FSS originals against physical lots today, then review the actual R7 test dates and QA disposition with Aaron and Sam before committing Roon’s run.

ACT NOW 3: Heritage — resolve the debtor dispute before disposal. Joseph’s new reply says Flex placed the order and owes the balance. Your December 3 disposal/collections warning is five days away; liability and authorized stock handling need human review, not another invoice chase. Send internally: Sam and Finance, reconcile the Flex/Heritage contracting party, invoices and stock today, and approve the payment and product-handling response before any disposal or collections action.

next: Recommendation: Resolve Silk first, then close the documented QC handoff and Roon test-versus-run decision.

Scheduled: Five calendar events through Wednesday morning; nearest Monday November 30 at 9:30 AM Eastern, tentative. Ecolab 11 AM overlaps a tentative team meeting. CRM: 19 active, 12 overdue, five future, two undated; none dated due within 48 hours.

Heritage’s new counterparty dispute takes the separate third slot; the COA action is consolidated with Roon/Luke QC, not cleared. Hunter remains displaced, not cleared.
